title.en: 【Spreek：Swell DAO 的 swETH 与 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，分析报告由 Claude 辅助撰写】

current_state.zh: Chain analyst Spreek reports a suspected leak of Swell DAO's swETH and rswETH admin keys, with attackers inflating NAV by up to 1% per hour and deploying four malicious upgrade contracts that could endanger roughly 2,500 ETH.
